posts.subject: New bugg?
posts.bodyHtml:
Hey there, I notice some sort of new bugg on the knife server and I don't know if any of the other servers have that but either way. (It's on the knife server btw) But sometimes when a new map change it can get stuck and that have been that for some time now everybody knows about it and players can just type "rtv" to fix it or a admin can just change map, but if the map change normaly sometimes for whatever reason only 2 people can join, one on ct and one on t site, everyone else can just join spec or you get like kicked out, this can be fixed if for exemple I change the map but I will see a problem for this is there are no admins active, just 2 people can play and it can't be fixed until a new map starts.
Idk if anyone else knew about this or if this old af but I don't think so cause it's started today for me and I'm on the server everyday.


Thank you for taking this notice and hopefully it will be fixed! [dgrün*]

Yes, this has been an re-occurring issue on Re-Take and GhostStrike too for all I know. The problem is, as stated by WHAT, when a new round starts, you spawn like normal but you are stuck. Not just stuck as in you can't move and you're standing on the ground, but you seem to be in mid-air as you can't aim straightforwardly if you are stuck (your shots go off target).
okay but when you join on the knife server, you can move and such but the only really problem is that only 2 players can play but yeah that's really good to know!

This is certainly an issue that needs to be looked at in depth, especially considering that there is not an admin on at every time of the day. Even though there is calladmin and privte message, there is no guarantee that the issue will be fixed. It's happened to me multiple times now and I'm sure that if it's fustrating me then it will certainly be fustrating players in general. Any chance you can take a look into this @Nachtfrische?

ADD: sometimes when a there are let's say 5 in each teams (or any type amount just enough for them to join a team) and a player joins the server, but then can't join a team and only spec mode, this can also be fix with switching map, idk if some maps does it but i don't so tho
